item.tib: yi dam kun 'dus kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi lag len man ngag gsal byed lde mig
item.coloph: ces pas sa bcad lnga ru bgos pa yi/ lag len man ngag gsal byed nyams len 'di/ yi dam kun 'dus bsnyen sgrub spyi sdom du/ dgos ched che bar mngags pa'i mdza' bshes lags/ yi dam kun 'dus bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi/ lag len man ngag gsal ba'i lde mig 'di/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / rin chen lhun grub gnyis kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ shing glang hor zla gnyis pa'i yar tshes la/ dben gnas dam pa dkar mo ri khrod du/ gsang ba'i sngags 'dzin nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis/ rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi/ ris drug rang sbyong gdams pa nyams len zhor/ bka' dang lung la brten nas brtsams pa 'di/ skal ldan shes rgyud smin grol mthar phyin phyir/ phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur nas/ bstan pa mi nub 'phrin las srid mtha'i bar/ nam mkha'i gdos dang mnyam par gyur cig gu/
